text: Scale audit found the frozen v2 execution cannot be treated as a credible one-job GitHub court: 144 workloads x 2 courts x 4 implementations x (5 warmup + 20 measured) x 2 core settings = 57,600 fresh-process rows. The registered rank-four shapes average about 68 MB per Float64 corrected output uncompressed, so retaining every output is about 3.9 TB before gzip. A GitHub self-hosted job can run longer than the default, but GITHUB_TOKEN expires after 24 hours, making post-run attestation/upload unreliable. Before AC-433-01/03/06 can close, choose and preregister either a statistically justified smaller timing/sensitivity panel with designated-output retention, or a resumable multi-job court with persistent content-addressed evidence and a final under-24-hour attestation job. No result has been run.
